name: Infra Monitor
tagline: Monitor any fleet of Linux/SSH machines from your desktop — health, load, logins, services, and optionally GPUs — with a tray dashboard and alerts.
description: Infra Monitor is a local desktop agent that watches a fleet of Linux/SSH machines and shows their health at a glance: reachability, load, disk and memory, listening ports, logins and possible intrusions, service checks, and — optionally, per machine — GPU/NVIDIA and other custom probes. It polls over SSH on an interval, raises desktop toast alerts on anomalies, and keeps a system-tray dashboard. Everything is user-configurable through a simple machines.json (see machines.example.json): you define your own hosts, users, jump host, allowlisted networks, poll interval and per-machine checks. Nothing is hardcoded and nothing leaves your machine.
